risk_summary: The excerpt contains substantial boilerplate, extensive non-GAAP adjustments, and complex disclosures that can make underlying performance harder to assess. Reported results indicate meaningful deterioration, including an 11.6% revenue decline, a $315.0 million impairment charge, and a shift to a $236.2 million operating loss, compounded by higher interest expense. Promotional positioning and adjusted metrics partially offset but do not eliminate the adverse risk tone.
